# First Grade

> Federal internships and entry-level jobs open now for students and recent grads, searchable by closing date, GS grade, state and agency, updated daily from USAJOBS data.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [Federal Internships for College Students: Pathways Guide 2026](https://aobaworks.com/federal-entry-jobs/federal-internships-for-college-students/): Federal internships for college students: who can apply to Pathways, pay and conversion rules, where postings appear, and how to search USAJOBS by path.
- [GS-7 Requirements: Superior Academic Achievement, Grad School](https://aobaworks.com/federal-entry-jobs/gs-7-requirements/): GS-7 requirements for students: Superior Academic Achievement (GPA, class rank, honor society), one year of grad school, or GS-5-level experience.
- [Pathways Recent Graduates Program Eligibility: 2-Year Rule](https://aobaworks.com/federal-entry-jobs/pathways-recent-graduates-program-eligibility/): Pathways Recent Graduates eligibility explained: the 2-year window, the 6-year veteran rule, which degrees and certificates count, and how to find jobs.
- [What GS Level Do I Qualify For? Grades by Degree and Experience](https://aobaworks.com/federal-entry-jobs/what-gs-level-do-i-qualify-for/): What GS level do I qualify for? See typical entry grades by degree, from high school to PhD, plus how specialized experience and job announcements decide.
- [Federal Resume vs Regular Resume: 7 Differences, 2-Page Rule](https://aobaworks.com/federal-entry-jobs/federal-resume-vs-regular-resume-7-differences-2-page-rule/): Federal resume vs regular resume: compare length, keyword matching, and duty rules side by side, plus USAJOBS Resume Builder steps for students.
